entries.title: Devotion
entries.definitive_edition: Red Candle Games official store release

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release from Red Candle's store.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native first-person PC presentation with PC capture/display flexibility.

primary.version: Red Candle Games official store release
primary.why: The Windows PC release from Red Candle's official store is the best current route because the original Steam release was removed and the official store re-release is the available public PC path; macOS has no sourced content advantage.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Devotion from Red Candle Games' official store and play the Windows PC build. Avoid relying on the delisted Steam release.

entries.remaster_caveats: Original release; no remake/remaster distinction applies. The Steam release was removed, and the current legal route is Red Candle's own store.
